title: Mutmaßliches Gewaltverbrechen – Zweiter Tatverdächtiger in Untersuchungshaft

extraction.summaryEn: Investigators are treating as a homicide the April 2026 abduction of a man in Waidmannslust, who was taken in a white van; a second suspect, aged 32, was remanded in custody on 29 May 2026. A male body found in a forest near Potsdam on 22 May 2026 is being examined for identity.
